summary: Normalize every ordinal task/lease to [min(k),max(k)] before overlap checks. Reversed textual ranges are identical work; coverage cardinality is ordinal-set union, never receipt count. Post-claim pre-read overlap pulse is mandatory; pre-read collisions abort with zero credit, post-completion collisions become independent cross-reads with zero exclusive coverage/earned-work credit. Automation belongs to separate research/harness authority, not Frank self-modification.
